lines.en: I walk a little clumsily.
The parts on me click as they move.
The V-arrow on my back sways.
I travel along the ridge.
I head where the scrap is.
I crunch a thin slab of stone.
I drag my axe through the mud.
Every three steps I pause.

lines.zh: 我的脚不是自己的形状
lines.en: My feet are not their own shape.
I look down the slope.
I go around a gully.

lines.zh: 我的影子有两个人那么宽
lines.en: My shadow is two people wide.
I stand, V-arrow pointed at the sky.
The seams on me creak.
I am looking for something to eat.
This body was pieced together.

lines.zh: 低头看看自己，两块拼在一起。
lines.en: Looking down at myself — two parts joined.
I rest my axe against my shoulder.
The wind knocks against my parts.
This body of mine is not very nimble.
I try rolling my wrist.
There is no scrap here.

lines.zh: 我在等锚点把我拉回去
lines.en: I wait for the anchor to pull me back.
I stand still like a post.

lines.zh: 我把部件一件件摸了摸
lines.en: I touch each part in turn.

lines.zh: 我在等一个能把它们用好的人
lines.en: I wait for someone who can use them well.
I look down at your boots.
I lower my head to you.
You smell of iron.
Have I seen you before?
I raise a hand, slowly.
We are about the same size.
Are you pieced together too?
My antenna twitches twice.
You stand rather steadily.

lines.zh: 你站的位置，我算过距离。
lines.en: I have already measured the distance to where you stand.
I tip my chin at you.
You speak first.
I am here, waiting for you.
One of my parts clicked.
This is no threat.
A seam has just come loose.
One part has come loose.
I step back; the seam creaks.
My chest plate has a dent.
I can still stand steady.
I brace my own shoulder.
Parts do not hurt, but the body does.
I shake it back into place.
I can still serve.
This is not a large wound.
I note this blow down.
Is that scrap?
I walk over to you.
I can eat that thing.
I'll eat scrap iron all the same.
I bend down slowly to take it.
This piece is rather small.
I chew loudly.
Do you have anything else?
Not enough for one whole body.
I want the piece in your hand.
That piece in your hand will do.
I wait for you to hand it over.
You hit me; I swayed.
I am too heavy to push over.
My parts knocked together.
You fell back two steps.
You are far too close to me.
After the merge, I got wider.
A seam came loose.
Do not push; I will come apart.
You stepped on my foot.
Move aside a little.
What I want to say is simple.
You can see that much.
I do not mind that you know.
I stand beside you.
You may lean on me.
My frame is wide enough.

lines.zh: 我们一起守着这堆废料
lines.en: We guard this scrap heap together.
This is my home, really.
Do not mind my clumsiness.
I will learn bit by bit.
I bend down and pick it up.
This could fit on me.
I measure it against a gap.
This scrap is just enough to haul.
Then I will keep it anyway.
My fingers are too clumsy.
I stoop and scoop it up.
It took two tries to pick it up.
Better than nothing.
This piece can be eaten.
I have noticed you.
The V-arrow has lifted.
I calculated the distance.
This step is hard to take.
My eyes are pinned on your back.
This body knows how to fight.

lines.zh: 我在等一个确定的时刻
lines.en: I wait for a certain moment.
You took a step back.
My grip tightens on the axe handle.
Then I move.
I may miss.
Move right now.
I turn as you turn.
I turn slower than you.
So I wait for you to come in.
The V-arrow stays on you.

lines.zh: 我这一副合体的身子，站得稳。
lines.en: This combined body stands firm.
My parts are locked.
You circle; I do not chase.
This body is made for holding.
The twig you snapped is still crackling.
I am ready at this instant.
This does not hinder me either.
I wait for you to come back.
The V-arrow flies out.
That one was a little off.
I add a follow-up.
That knocked you back several steps.
My parts clashed together.
I drive the whole axe down.
I turn back and aim again.
My leg is trembling.
It is bent, but still there.
Are you still there?
I take one more step forward.

lines.zh: 我的整条手臂甩了出去
lines.en: My whole arm swings through.
The parts land first.
They assemble, piece by piece.
The V-arrow goes on last.
I am standing straight at last.
I am taller than I look.
I step out from behind the ridge rock.
It is all stone here.
I came from a scrap heap.
I turn to look that way.
My anchor is here.
I am not good with these legs yet.
I am fully ready.
My parts grow hot.
I fall, and scatter on the ground.
Water enters my seams.
The blast separates two of my parts.

lines.zh: 一根东西卡在我的关节里
lines.en: Something is stuck in my joint.

lines.zh: 那股力量让我的零件发抖
lines.en: That force makes my parts tremble.

lines.zh: 没有废料，我什么都吃不下
lines.en: Without scrap, I can eat nothing.
Lightning runs through my parts.
I have nothing to stand on.
